sheets.name: Room Condition Log
sheets.notes: One row per item or surface. Photo ID links each row to the Photo Inventory Sheet. J flags rows missing photos or initials. This log is for factual condition notes only. Verify state rules locally for required checklist wording.

example_rows: Close-up with ruler for scale (illustrative example)
sheets.name: Photo Inventory Sheet
sheets.notes: One row per photo. J counts photos per room to reveal thin coverage. Keep original files unedited with timestamps intact. Store backups in a second location.

sheets.name: Signature Tracker
sheets.notes: Enter M1 on this sheet as the move-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) so Days From Move-In computes correctly. J2 counts missing signatures. PENDING means the signature is still open. Verify state rules locally for signature and delivery deadlines.

sheets.name: Wear Vs Damage Reference
sheets.notes: Reference only for consistent note-taking. Normal wear vs damage definitions vary by state and lease. Verify state rules locally. F2 counts reference rows; F3 shows note length for the first row as a simple completeness nudge. This sheet is not legal advice.
